2608.15032.title: Handoff-H1: An Orchestrated Vision-Agent System for Material Quantity Takeoff from Construction Blueprints
2608.15032.paper_summary: Converting a set of architectural blueprints into a complete material quantity takeoff requires visual perception across drawing sheets, dimensional and multi-hop reasoning, and grounding in construction conventions that the drawings never state. We present Handoff-H1, a takeoff system built from three layers: purpose-built computer-vision models that extract primitives; tool-using agents equipped with image operations and in-house visual-task tools, including CV-model-backed counting, detection and plan decomposition; and a persistent, hierarchically structured project foundation, grounded in a curated construction knowledge base. We evaluate on the Construction Blueprint Takeoff Benchmark: 10 real residential blueprint sets paired with consensus-validated expert takeoffs - 2,009 verified line items, restricted for scoring to the 1,348 primary-tier materials that drive an estimate - scored per trade by an LLM judge on material coverage and quantity Precision@25% (P@.25) and combined into a weighted composite. Under identical scoring from the raw PDF, seven frontier and open-weight models span composites of 35-61, and independent professional estimators - scored against the same reconciled gold standard - post 77.6% (65.5% coverage, 87.9% P@.25). Handoff-H1, working end-to-end from the raw PDF, reaches 81.6% (86.1% coverage, 78.8% P@.25): roughly 20 points above the strongest frontier agent, and above the independent estimators by pairing near-human quantity precision with coverage they do not reach. The evaluation harness is public for the open harbor framework; the blueprint sets and ground truth are available upon request for research use.
2608.15032.paper_summary_zh: 將一組建築藍圖轉換為完整的材料數量清單需要在圖紙之間進行視覺感知、尺寸和多跳推理，以及對建築慣例的理解，而這些慣例在圖紙中並未明確說明。我們提出了Handoff-H1，一個由三個層次組成的清單系統：專門構建的計算機視覺模型用於提取基本元素；配備圖像操作和內部視覺任務工具的工具使用代理，包括基於CV模型的計數、檢測和計劃分解；以及一個持久的、分層結構的項目基礎，基於精心策劃的建築知識庫。我們在建築藍圖清單基準上進行評估：10組真實的住宅藍圖集，與共識驗證的專家清單配對 - 2,009個經過驗證的項目，限制計分在1,348個主要材料上，這些材料驅動估算 - 按行業由LLM評審根據材料覆蓋率和數量的Precision@25% (P@.25)進行評分，並合併為加權綜合分數。在從原始PDF進行相同評分的情況下，七個前沿和開放權重模型的綜合分數範圍為35-61，而獨立專業估算師 - 根據相同的對賬黃金標準進行評分 - 得到77.6%（65.5%覆蓋率，87.9% P@.25）。Handoff-H1從原始PDF端到端工作，達到81.6%（86.1%覆蓋率，78.8% P@.25）：大約比最強的前沿代理高出20個點，並且通過結合接近人類的數量精度與他們無法達到的覆蓋率超過獨立估算師。評估工具對於開放港口框架是公開的；藍圖集和真實數據可根據要求提供以供研究使用。
